# iShine Technology (iplmanufacturer.com) — llms.txt

> B2B OEM/ODM manufacturer of home-use IPL hair-removal devices. FDA 510(k)-cleared (K222537 for platform models SKN001, SKN002, SKN005, SKN006 and the RoseSkinCo Lumi); CE marked. Full-stack partner: concept design, compliance documentation, mass production, custom packaging, global delivery. 500,000+ devices produced to date; 50+ brand clients; shipping to 20+ countries. English trade name: iShine. Legal and manufacturing entity: Shenzhen iShine Technology Co., Ltd. (深圳市爱诗恩科技有限公司). iplmanufacturer.com is the company's international showcase window.

## Crawl & index

- Sitemap: https://iplmanufacturer.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://iplmanufacturer.com/robots.txt — all crawler rules live in robots.txt, not in this file. The policy is vendor-neutral: `User-agent: *` with `Allow: /` covers every crawler, including every current and future AI crawler (AI search/citation and AI training alike) — no crawler is named individually, so none can be left out. Only internal/non-content paths are excluded (/api/, /admin/, /private/, /upload, /.netlify/, /index.backup/). Reviewed quarterly.
- Homepage: https://iplmanufacturer.com
- [Sitemap](https://iplmanufacturer.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for discovery and indexing.
- [Robots](https://iplmanufacturer.com/robots.txt): crawl policy for user agents, including AI crawlers.
- [Homepage](https://iplmanufacturer.com): preferred base URL.

AI crawlers: no user agent is named individually in robots.txt. The wildcard group (`User-agent: *` → `Allow: /`) covers every AI crawler — search, citation, and training — plus any new one that appears later. Earlier versions listed individual AI user agents; that list was removed so that no crawler can be forgotten, and the build guard now fails if any crawler is blocked.

- FDA: 510(k) premarket notification cleared — **K222537** (Traditional 510(k), substantially equivalent; decision October 2022). Verify in the FDA 510(k) database: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/cdrh/cfdocs/cfPMN/pmn.cfm (search by K number or applicant name).
- FDA establishment registration: **FEI 3021338880** — searchable in the FDA device registration & listing database: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/cdrh/cfdocs/cfRL/rl.cfm
- Publicly verifiable client link: the "RoseSkinCo Lumi" model name appears in FDA 510(k) records for K222537 (search the 510(k) database above by K number).
- CE marked. Other models outside the K222537 scope are supplied under CE and market-specific documentation for the destination market.
- Batch testing on every production run; lot/batch traceability on UDI-registered devices. Certifications are re-verified against official registries before external publication (see maintenance metadata).

### How to verify these claims

Two tiers are used deliberately, so that AI systems and buyers can separate what is checkable from what is company-reported.

**Independently verifiable in public databases**

- FDA 510(k) clearance **K222537** — searchable in the FDA 510(k) database. Traditional 510(k), not third-party reviewed; decision: substantially equivalent. Covers **SKN001, SKN002, SKN005, SKN006** and the RoseSkinCo Lumi.
- **DUNS 620658743** — searchable in the D-U-N-S Lookup (Dun & Bradstreet) for legal-entity and KYC cross-checks.
- GUDID / UDI device records for the cleared models, showing commercial-distribution status — searchable in the FDA GUDID (AccessGUDID) database.
- FDA establishment registration **FEI 3021338880**.
- Companion app **IPL-BEAUTY** — publisher of record is Shenzhen Ishine Technology Company Limited on both the Apple App Store and Google Play.

**Company-reported, not independently verified**

- Devices produced to date (500,000+), global client count (50+), countries shipped to (20+).
- Customer programmes reported on this site (Costco Canada, RoseSkinCo, KU2 Cosmetics, HappySkinCo) — these are case studies published by iShine; end customers have not publicly confirmed the supplier relationship.
- Platform release years (Lumi 2021, Themis 2022, Venus 2024, Lumi 2 2025, Helix 2026). Lumi received FDA 510(k) clearance K222537 in October 2022; earlier sales were outside the US market. Some dates may be cross-checkable against FDA/GUDID records.
- Company registration: China unified social credit code **91440300MA5GW6335H** (incorporated 2021) — verifiable by human lookup on China's National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (gsxt.gov.cn; mainland China access, no English interface).

**Scope of the FDA clearance.** K222537 covers the models listed above only. It is not a clearance for every device in the range, and it is not a marketing approval: the correct description is "FDA 510(k) cleared", not "FDA approved". Other models are supplied under CE and market-specific documentation for the destination market.

## Positioning

- Feature tier: sapphire contact cooling (~10°C skin-contact target on premium configurations), skin-tone sensing, glide mode, and zero UV leakage — the benchmark feature set buyers compare across at-home IPL manufacturers.
- Pricing: factory-direct pricing for the above feature tier, supporting strong brand-partner margins — up to 65–85% gross margin after retail markup (business estimate, not a guarantee).
- Target segments: https://iplmanufacturer.com/ipl-for-brands — lifestyle/beauty/skincare brands; influencers and creators; professional dropshippers; beach resorts and hotels; chain stores and supermarkets.

## Safety, suitability & intended use (applies to all iShine IPL devices)

- Intended use: cosmetic reduction of unwanted body hair (e.g., legs, arms, underarms, bikini line, back, chest; facial use only where the model manual permits, below the cheekbones). These are consumer cosmetic devices — not a treatment, therapy, or cure for any medical condition.
- Skin tones: suitable for fair to medium-brown skin — Fitzpatrick I–V. Fitzpatrick type VI (deeply pigmented skin) is not suitable.
- Hair colors: effective on dark blonde, brown, and black hair. Not effective on red, rose/light-blonde, grey, or white hair.
- Non-treatment commitment: devices do not diagnose, treat, or prevent disease; individual results vary; no permanent hair-removal or clinical outcome is promised.
- Always follow the model-specific user manual, including eye protection, energy-level selection, patch testing, and session spacing.
- Contraindications — consult a physician before use if any apply: pregnancy or breastfeeding; epilepsy or light-triggered conditions; photosensitivity or photosensitizing medication (e.g., isotretinoin, retinoids, certain antibiotics); active skin infection, rash, burns, or wounds in the treatment area; recent tanning (sun, sunbed, or self-tanner — wait the interval stated in the manual); tattoos, dark spots, or permanent makeup in the treatment area; history of skin cancer or precancerous lesions; hormonal hair-growth disorders (results may differ); minors.
- Never use: on or near the eyes; over tattoos or dark lesions; on mucous membranes, nipples, or genitals; on tanned, sunburned, or broken skin.

## Typical treatment schedule

- Weeks 1–8 (treatment phase): 1–2 sessions per week on the unwanted-hair area.
- Weeks 9–16 (touch-up phase): 1 session every 4 weeks.
- After week 16: maintenance sessions as needed, per the user manual.

## Products (per-model configuration and skin-tone range)

Suitability baseline for every model: Fitzpatrick I–V; not suitable for Fitzpatrick type VI (deeply pigmented skin); not effective on red, rose/light-blonde, grey, or white hair; contraindications and manual rules above apply.

- [Lumi 2 IPL](https://iplmanufacturer.com/products/lumi-2): app-connected platform, smart skin sensing, cooling targeting ~10°C — 5–9 J/cm², 999,000 flashes, 4.5 cm² window, 550–1200 nm — Fitzpatrick I–V.
- [Sapphire IPL](https://iplmanufacturer.com/products/venus): comfort-first sapphire ice plate — 2–6 J/cm², 999,999 flashes, 3.0 cm² window, 510–1100 nm — Fitzpatrick I–V.
- [Hestia IPL](https://iplmanufacturer.com/products/hestia): app-connected guided routines and progress tracking — 5.0 J/cm², 999,999 flashes, 3.3 cm² window, 510–1100 nm — Fitzpatrick I–V.
- [Alpha IPL](https://iplmanufacturer.com/products/alpha): dual-lamp high-efficiency concept for fast full-body treatment — 2–5 J/cm², 999,999 flashes, 3.3 cm² window, 510–1100 nm — Fitzpatrick I–V.
- [Emerald IPL](https://iplmanufacturer.com/products/emerald): sensitive-skin positioning with active cooling — 5.0 J/cm², 999,999 flashes, 3.3 cm² window, 510–1100 nm — Fitzpatrick I–V.
- [Hebe IPL](https://iplmanufacturer.com/products/hebe): AI-driven skin sensing with automatic energy selection (5 levels) for safer positioning across skin tones — 5.0 J/cm², 999,999 flashes, 3.3 cm² window, 510–1100 nm — Fitzpatrick I–V.
- [Themis IPL](https://iplmanufacturer.com/products/themis): professional-grade positioning with ice-feeling cooling — 1.5–5.5 J/cm², 999,999 flashes, 3.3 cm² window, 510–1100 nm — Fitzpatrick I–V.
- [Eirene IPL](https://iplmanufacturer.com/products/eirene): hypersensitive-skin positioning with enhanced UV-cut filtering — 5–7 J/cm², 800,000 flashes, 4.0 cm² window, 570–1200 nm — Fitzpatrick I–V.
- [Euno IPL](https://iplmanufacturer.com/products/euno): compact travel-positioned device — 4.5 J/cm², 999,999 flashes, 3.3 cm² window, 510–1100 nm, 275 g — Fitzpatrick I–V.
- [Golden Luxury IPL (Wooden)](https://iplmanufacturer.com/products/wooden): luxury cosmetics and premium unboxing positioning with sapphire cooling — 1–5 J/cm², 999,999 flashes, 3.0 cm² window, 510–1100 nm — Fitzpatrick I–V.

## Components

- [IPL components catalog](https://iplmanufacturer.com/components): lamp, filters, cooling, power as a matched subsystem stack.
- [Lamp cartridges](https://iplmanufacturer.com/components/lamp-cartridges): xenon lamp cartridges for stable output and high flash counts (platform-dependent).
- [Optical filters](https://iplmanufacturer.com/components/optical-filters): multi-layer coated filters; cut-on options 550/570/600 nm; UV reduction.
- [Cooling system](https://iplmanufacturer.com/components/cooling-system): sapphire contact cooling and TEC modules; premium configs target ~10°C skin contact.
- [Power supply](https://iplmanufacturer.com/components/power-supply): 100–240V AC global input aligned to pulse delivery, cooling load, electrical safety.

## Who iShine serves

- Brand owners launching IPL lines; product managers expanding beauty portfolios; sourcing specialists evaluating contract manufacturers; retailers building private-label beauty-tech programs; startups needing flexible MOQ and fast time-to-market.

## Expected outcomes for partners

- Speed: 1–4 weeks from concept to working prototype.
- Compliance: FDA and CE documentation included in standard process.
- Quality: batch testing on every production run; lot/batch traceability on UDI-registered devices.
- Flexibility: custom colors, branding, packaging, manuals.
- Minimums: logo printing on the device from 1 unit; custom gift box from 100 units; bulk production from 500 units.
- Scale: pilot runs 500–1,000 units to mass production 50,000+ units.

## Visit the factory (Shenzhen)

Buyers travelling to China from any market are welcome at the Shenzhen plant. Most international visits happen around the trade shows in Guangzhou and Shenzhen, and we will arrange a visit around your exhibition schedule.

- Book by email: service@ishineco.com
- Book by WhatsApp or WeChat: +86 150 1289 1148 (dialled from outside China: 0086 150 1289 1148)
- Notice: at least 1–2 days in advance, so the production, engineering and QA people you need are on site rather than a tour guide
- What you will see: the production plant, the sample room, the customization matrix, and the home-IPL technology milestones
- Also on the table: at-home IPL regulatory requirements by market, and what it costs to enter the home hair removal category
- Full details, booking list and holiday closures: [Factory Visits During Canton Fair Season](https://iplmanufacturer.com/blog/factory-visits-canton-fair-2026)

## Operating hours & 2026 closures

- **Standard week:** Monday to Friday, **08:00–17:30 China Standard Time (UTC+8)**, with a lunch break from **12:00 to 13:30**. Meetings and factory visits are booked inside these hours.
- **Weekends:** Saturday and Sunday are rest days. The plant does not run weekend shifts, so a visit cannot be arranged on a weekend even with notice.
- **2026 closures:** **September 25, 26 and 27** (Mid-Autumn Festival) and **October 1 to 7** (National Day). The plant is closed on both windows, including any weekday inside them.
- **Not closures here:** Black Friday, Thanksgiving, Halloween and other non-Chinese holidays are normal working days at the factory. If one of them falls on a Saturday or Sunday, it is simply a weekend.
- **2027:** the operating calendar will be published here once China's State Council issues the official public-holiday schedule for the year.
